item.title: Under-Sink Organization Ideas: A Measured, Leak-Aware System
item.description: Open the cabinet under almost any sink and you will see the same scene: pipes down the middle, bottles that drifted to the back, and a floor nobody has looked at in months. The fix is not another set of bins. It is a layout drawn around your actual plumbing, plus a simple way to catch a leak early. This guide gives you a six-point measuring method, a zone layout that works around a central drain, a short safety section for household chemicals, and a printable measure-and-layout sheet to take to the cabinet.

item.title: Magnetic Spice Storage for Renters: Test the Surface, Mind the Weight and Heat
item.description: A small rental kitchen can feel crowded long before it runs out of storage, and spices are a classic example: you use them often, but a drawer of small jars is hard to scan and counter jars add clutter. A magnetic rack can fix that without a drill, as in the cover photo. But it is a small storage system with three conditions: the surface has to be magnetic, the load has to stay within the rack’s limit and the spices have to be kept away from heat.
